snippets.name: Tenant-Uebersicht
snippets.description: Name, Domaenen, Lizenzen und Geraeteanzahl des Tenants (geht auch fuer mehrere Tenants)
snippets.code:
# Tenant-Uebersicht
# Berechtigungen: Organization.Read.All, DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
$org  = (Invoke-GraphRequest -Token $Token -Endpoint '/organization?$select=displayName,verifiedDomains,createdDateTime').value[0]
$skus = @(Invoke-GraphRequestAll -Token $Token -Endpoint '/subscribedSkus?$select=skuPartNumber,consumedUnits,prepaidUnits')
$dev  = @(Invoke-GraphRequestAll -Token $Token -Endpoint '/deviceManagement/managedDevices?$select=id,operatingSystem')

Write-Host "$($org.displayName)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ("  Domaenen: " + (@($org.verifiedDomains | ForEach-Object { $_.name }) -join ', '))
Write-Host "  Intune-Geraete: $($dev.Count)"

[pscustomobject]@{
    Tenant        = $TenantKey
    Name          = $org.displayName
    Domaene       = (@($org.verifiedDomains | Where-Object { $_.isDefault }) | Select-Object -First 1).name
    Geraete       = $dev.Count
    Windows       = @($dev | Where-Object { $_.operatingSystem -eq 'Windows' }).Count
    iOS           = @($dev | Where-Object { $_.operatingSystem -eq 'iOS' }).Count
    Android       = @($dev | Where-Object { $_.operatingSystem -eq 'Android' }).Count
    Lizenzen      = ($skus | Measure-Object -Property consumedUnits -Sum).Sum
}

snippets.name: Geraete ohne Sync
snippets.description: Intune-Geraete, die sich seit X Tagen nicht gemeldet haben - Tabelle mit Benutzer und letztem Sync
snippets.code:
# Intune-Geraete ohne Synchronisierung seit X Tagen
# Berechtigungen: DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
# @param Tage|int|Ohne Sync seit Tagen|30
# @param NurWindows|bool|Nur Windows|false

$grenze = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$Tage)
$dev = @(Invoke-GraphRequestAll -Token $Token -Endpoint '/deviceManagement/managedDevices?$select=deviceName,operatingSystem,osVersion,lastSyncDateTime,userPrincipalName,complianceState,serialNumber,model')
if ($NurWindows) { $dev = @($dev | Where-Object { $_.operatingSystem -eq 'Windows' }) }
$alt = @($dev | Where-Object { [datetime]$_.lastSyncDateTime -lt $grenze } | Sort-Object { [datetime]$_.lastSyncDateTime })
Write-Host "$($alt.Count) von $($dev.Count) Geraeten seit mehr als $Tage Tagen ohne Sync" -ForegroundColor Yellow

foreach ($d in $alt) {
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Geraet      = $d.deviceName
        Benutzer    = $d.userPrincipalName
        LetzterSync = ([datetime]$d.lastSyncDateTime).ToLocalTime()
        Tage        = [int]((Get-Date) - [datetime]$d.lastSyncDateTime).TotalDays
        System      = "$($d.operatingSystem) $($d.osVersion)"
        Modell      = $d.model
        Seriennr    = $d.serialNumber
        Compliance  = $d.complianceState
    }
}

snippets.name: Lizenzen
snippets.description: Gekaufte und verwendete Lizenzen je Produkt (SKU)
snippets.code:
# Lizenzuebersicht
# Berechtigungen: Organization.Read.All
$skus = @(Invoke-GraphRequestAll -Token $Token -Endpoint '/subscribedSkus')
foreach ($s in $skus | Sort-Object skuPartNumber) {
    $gesamt = [int]$s.prepaidUnits.enabled
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Produkt  = $s.skuPartNumber
        Gesamt   = $gesamt
        Verwendet = [int]$s.consumedUnits
        Frei     = $gesamt - [int]$s.consumedUnits
        Gesperrt = [int]$s.prepaidUnits.suspended
        Status   = $s.capabilityStatus
    }
}
